evidence.quote: So, no, it is not time yet.
However, these one-time increases in prices are likely to have only transitory effects on inflation.
we will continue to increase our holdings of Treasury securities by at least $80 billion per month and of agency mortgage-backed securities by at least $40 billion per month
We got a really nice job report for March. It doesn’t constitute substantial further progress. It’s not close to substantial further progress.
I would note that a transitory rise in inflation above 2 percent this year would not meet this standard.

If, if, contrary to expectations, inflation were to move persistently and materially above 2 percent in a manner that threatened to move longer-term inflation expectations materially above 2 percent, we would use our tools

parsed.rationale: Powell holds rates at zero and maintains $120 billion per month in purchases. He firmly rejects taper talk, calls the inflation rise transitory and stresses the large employment shortfall, while offering only a conditional pledge to respond if inflation proves persistent.
